title: Creating & Managing Databases
description: Create databases, configure templates (template0, template1), set encodings (UTF8), and configure collations.

data.text: In PostgreSQL, a **database cluster** is a single running PostgreSQL server instance that manages multiple independent databases. Each database is an isolated namespace containing its own tables, schemas, and catalogs.

data.title: Creating a Production Database with UTF8 and ICU Collation
data.code:
CREATE DATABASE production_app
    WITH 
    OWNER = app_admin
    ENCODING = 'UTF8'
    LC_COLLATE = 'en_US.UTF-8'
    LC_CTYPE = 'en_US.UTF-8'
    TEMPLATE = template1;

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: A PostgreSQL cluster hosts multiple independent databases.
New databases copy schemas and extensions from `template1`.
